title: Research consolidation: bind PR116 evidence-only head to tested sources (no new kappa)
body:
This independent historical source/evidence check is now integrated with the current ledger without undoing PR116's later completed review and closure. A scoped `PARENT-EVIDENCE.json` input and the ledger generator append one evidence pointer; both regenerated ledger files preserve every existing disposition, head, attribution, review-completion field and closure receipt across all 2,356 records. PR116 remains incorporated/CLOSED, and PR1007 is not promoted to reviewed or incorporated. **No new kappa or selected-result change.**

The original offline standard-library checker and capsule are unchanged. It decodes 208 anchored Git objects and compares both complete historical trees (1,559 to 1,560 tracked paths). Exactly three paths change: README status, its SOURCE hash and an added author receipt. All 41 scientific/dependency objects retain identical Git IDs and modes. It also binds 42 saved historical check records and the actual synthetic merge checked out by three focused Python jobs. These are recovered historical executions, not a fresh supplier replay.

Scientific provenance remains `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`; PR116 scientific head `97750ec74fc714638c0aa4f31aaa880e56cb8b4d`, evidence head `295a48a3b966428896057a98c6b4834c0b4b7416`, historical focused checkout `0db8566d07ae1fd7765d5d98fbb32ad22775ed32`. Current integration base is `67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02`. README/CLAIM/VALIDATION now distinguish original submission-time status from the later incorporated decision.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/test_package.py
python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr116_ledger_evidence.py
python3 -B scripts/reconcile_pr_queue.py
make selected-record-check
```

Fresh CPython 3.14.6 replay, all 28 original tests, two new ledger regressions, byte-stable regeneration, complete ledger-preservation comparison, committed-byte comparison and selected-record integrity pass. The source capsule, result, producer and checker retain their original bytes. The broader historical reconciliation checker and suite fail identically on unmodified pinned main and this revision: a stale hyperplane source pin, an accepted-runner successor pin and seven superseded family projections. `VALIDATION.md` gives the exact commands and failures; they are not counted as successful checks. Hosted CI on the revision is separate.

Scope remains source identity and historical CI provenance. The author's standalone 3,733-second local archive was not recovered; only its receipt is retained. Full `make verify`, fresh supplier replay, Lean compilation and theorem admission are outside this package. The later [PR116 review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02/docs/research/community-reconciliation92-review.md) remains authoritative. This update addresses the [maintainer's integration request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1007#issuecomment-6161276240).

Credit: Rohan Arun's PR116 and validation receipt; Douglas Colkitt's earlier round-eight observation; icekylinx, eumemic, Avi Eisenberg, Rohan Gupta, Swapnil Jain and the inherited lineage retain attribution. Ross Richardson prepared this consolidation with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Frozen source inputs and `upstream/` remain unchanged by this contribution.
